translated: Right? It would be great if that motivation switch just stayed on all the time.
The "off" switch is just too powerful.
Alright, let's move on. This next one is from Radio name: Mutsuki.
"Rina Honnizumi-san and Minori Suzuki-san, kon-more, kon-niigo."
"I was grinding for a ProSeka event the other day, and I had Sekaraji playing while I was doing my runs."
"The cast's talk was so funny and soothing that the time just flew by. Do you two have anything that helps you get work done?"
"Do you two have anything that helps you get work done?"
I mean, if they're doing runs, that means they're playing the game...
So they're listening to us talk while playing a rhythm game.
That's like Prince Shotoku levels of multitasking.
They must have the songs memorized by now.
If they've played enough to know the notes and charts by heart, that's really flattering.
Something that helps us get things done...
